overview: Based on the published agenda, the Village of Kronenwetter Administrative Policy Committee was scheduled to meet to review financial reports, discuss the 2027 operating budget preview, and consider the 2027-2036 Capital Improvement Plan with funding and debt service analyses. The meeting was set to address the village's financial planning and budgetary priorities for the coming year.

agenda.item: Approval of August 18, 2026 Administrative Policy Committee Meeting Minutes

discussions.body: The committee was scheduled to review and take possible action on the minutes from the previous Administrative Policy Committee meeting held on August 18, 2026.
The Finance Director was set to provide a monthly update report to the committee regarding the village's financial status and activities.
The committee was expected to review the budget status report for August 2026 to assess financial performance through that period.
The committee was scheduled to discuss a preview of the 2027 operating budget to inform planning and deliberations on the upcoming year's financial priorities.

The committee was set to consider the Capital Improvement Plan for 2027-2036, including funding analysis, debt service analysis, and Tax Increment District projected closer analysis. This comprehensive capital planning review was expected to guide the village's long-term infrastructure and investment decisions.

publicComment: Public comment was scheduled, with a 15-minute total limit and three minutes per person, subject to extension at the Chief Presiding Officer's discretion. No action was to be taken under public comments.
